item.title: McDonald's suspends worker after 'free Palestine' rant at Israeli customers
item.description:

The customers, Asaf and Matan, said the dispute began over a missing burger and escalated when the worker asked where they were from. McDonald's Australia apologized and cited its zero-tolerance policy on antisemitism.
